question: Which one of the following is an example of a major tectonic plate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pacific plate**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Pacific plate** is one of the largest tectonic plates on Earth.
 
• Tectonic plates are massive slabs of solid rock, composed of both continental and oceanic lithosphere, which move and interact at their boundaries.
